study_title: Molecular responses and metabolic reset of apple fruit under postharvest low oxygen stress
study_description: In the present work we report data on the application of an integrated approach on apples held under two levels of low oxygen concentrations throughout the initial 2 months of storage, when, in general, strict control of the effects of the extremely low oxygen concentration is required for a successful DCA performance.
